lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple clusters of high-luminance circular pixels arranged in staggered horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that cross the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a subtle non-uniform grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature along the upper third of the flank showing a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with high-intensity pixels on the upper edge and a shadow region directly below.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense concentration of high-luminance circular spots is visible on the dorsal surface of the primary pectoral fin.
